_comment: Fill these in from your own experience. Neither number is a secret — they
are in the URLs of your own pages — which is why they live in the repo and
universeId: create.roblox.com -> Creations -> your experience. The number in
the URL after /experiences/ is the universe id.
placeId:    the same experience -> Places -> the place you want to publish.
The number in its URL (also the number in roblox.com/games/<id>).
The API key itself goes in the ROBLOX_API_KEY environment variable and
nowhere else. Never put it in this file; this file is committed.
